description: This module adds hosts to or removes them from IBM Spectrum Accelerate Family storage systems.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: The name of the cluster to include the host.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domains the cluster is attached to. To include more than one domain, separate domain names with commas. To include all existing domains, use an asterisk (*).

parameters.name: endpoints
parameters.description: The hostname or management IP of Spectrum Accelerate storage system.

parameters.name: iscsi_chap_secret
parameters.description: The password of the initiator used to authenticate to the system when CHAP is enable.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for username on the Spectrum Accelerate storage system.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Management user on the Spectrum Accelerate storage system.

examples:
- name: Define new host.
  community.general.ibm_sa_host:
    host: host_name
    state: present
    username: admin
    password: secret
    endpoints: hostdev-system

- name: Delete host.
  community.general.ibm_sa_host:
    host: host_name
    state: absent
    username: admin
    password: secret
    endpoints: hostdev-system
